column18: Every time the player levels up, their base HP and Damage values increase,
and (up to level 50) they get a skill point (spent to upgrade their stats even more).
The damage value displayed on level-up is not affected by the skill point upgrades, but the HP value is...
As you can see, apart from the first few levels (up to 3? for HP, up to 3 for damage, up to 2 for EXP),
each value is a fixed multiple of the previous level's value (around 31/30 for HP, 1.08 for damage, 1.08 for EXP apart from level 30),
up to the softcap level 50 (which has higher multipliers in order to end on nice, round numbers).
Once you reach player level 50, the number becomes yellow, and additional level-ups are instead marked as
"50 +1", "50 +2", and so on, and befitting of the difference in notation these level-ups are completely different.
Now every level adds a fixed 0.5 base HP (rounded down) and 2 damage, and takes a constant 400,000 EXP, up to 50+999.
Because of this, additional levels do nearly nothing to make you stronger, and are moreso a marker of how much you've played.
